nodes.description: Private owner address of UniswapExchange; set to msg.sender in constructor and gate for privileged functions.
Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf holding token balances of UniswapExchange.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowance used by transferFrom.
Mapping(address=>bool) canSale whitelist consulted by ensure().
Whitelisted trade address settable by owner and trusted in ensure().
uint _saleNum sale-count limit configured by init().
uint _minSale minimum transfer amount configured by init().
uint _maxSale maximum transfer amount configured by init().
Mapping(address=>uint) _onSaleNum counting transfers per sender for sale limits.
Public uint totalSupply set in constructor from supply argument.
Constant uint decimals = 18 used for token scaling.
UniswapExchange constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and initial balances/allowance.
Public payable transfer() that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view ensure() whitelisting owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale senders, otherwise delegating to condition().
Public payable transferFrom() updating allowance and balances with raw unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve() writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without restriction.
Internal view condition() enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits.
Owner-only delegate() performing an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied address and calldata.
Public _mints() granting arbitrary balances and canSale flags to owner or a hardcoded privileged address.
Owner-only init() configuring _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batchSend() performing unchecked multiplication and looping balance credits.
Owner-only setTradeAddress() updating the trusted tradeAddress state variable.
Internal pure pairFor() deriving a Uniswap pair address via keccak256.
msg.sender attacker-controllable caller identity used for authorization in nearly all functions.
a.delegatecall(b) in delegate(): arbitrary external code executed in the contract's storage context.
Unchecked 'balanceOf[_from] -= _value' / 'allowance[...] -= _value' subtractions (Solidity 0.5 wrapping).
Unchecked 'uint total = _value * _tos.length' multiplication in batchSend().
Unbounded balance write 'balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals)' in _mints(); arbitrary value minting.
address _from parameter of ensure()/transferFrom()/condition().
address _to recipient parameter of transfer()/transferFrom().
uint _value amount parameter of transfer()/transferFrom().
address _spender parameter of approve().
address a target parameter of delegate().
Local _UNI pair address computed inside ensure() via pairFor().
address[] _tos recipient array parameter of batchSend().
address spender parameter of _mints() that receives the minted balance.
uint saleNum parameter of init().
Loop counter uint i in batchSend().
uint256 _supply constructor parameter used to set totalSupply.
address addr parameter of setTradeAddress().

edges.reason: Caller msg.sender is passed as _from into transfer(), which forwards to transferFrom().
msg.sender is read to compare against _from and to decrement allowance in transferFrom().
msg.sender is used as allowance owner key in approve().
msg.sender must equal owner for the privileged delegatecall path.
msg.sender must equal owner or a hardcoded address to mint in _mints().
msg.sender must equal owner to configure sale limits in init().
msg.sender must equal owner to execute batchSend().
msg.sender must equal owner to change tradeAddress.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender, granting all privileged rights to the deployer.
_from parameter controls which balance and allowance entries are mutated.
_to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom().
_value drives unchecked balance and allowance mutations in transferFrom().
transferFrom() performs raw unchecked subtraction on balances and allowance.
Unchecked subtraction result is written into the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf entries.
transferFrom() reads and writes allowance entries.
approve() writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender and _spender.
_spender parameter is the allowance key set by approve().
delegate() forwards attacker-supplied calldata into the arbitrary delegatecall.
Target address parameter a of delegate() determines the delegatecall destination.
_mints() writes an arbitrary, unchecked balance entry.
_mints() sets canSale[spender] = true, whitelisting an arbitrary address.
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender].
spender parameter selects the account credited in _mints().
init() assigns the _saleNum state variable.
init() assigns the _minSale state variable.
init() assigns the _maxSale state variable.
saleNum parameter flows into _saleNum in init().
batchSend() computes _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend() reads sender balance and credits each recipient in balanceOf.
_tos parameter is iterated to credit recipients in batchSend().
Loop index i bounds the batchSend() recipient iteration.
setTradeAddress() overwrites the trusted tradeAddress state variable.
addr parameter becomes the new tradeAddress.
Constructor initializes owner from msg.sender, establishing privileged roles.
Constructor sets totalSupply from _supply scaled by decimals.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the full supply.
Constructor sets an unlimited allowance for the Uniswap router.
_supply parameter is scaled and stored as totalSupply.
ensure() compares _from/_to against owner to bypass the sale condition.
ensure() consults canSale[_from] to whitelist senders.
ensure() trusts tradeAddress as a bypass sender.
Local _UNI pair address is computed and compared inside ensure().
condition() reads _saleNum to enforce the sale count limit.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce a minimum transfer amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce a maximum transfer amount.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
_to parameter is forwarded by transfer() to transferFrom().
transfer() delegates execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom() calls ensure() to validate the sender/recipient.
ensure() falls back to condition() when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address.
Arbitrary delegatecall executes external code in the contract context, which can re-enter transferFrom() and mutate balances/allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is the sole source address consumed by transferFrom() when mutating balances and allowances.
_to is the recipient consumed by transferFrom() and forwarded from transfer().
_value is the amount fed directly into the unchecked balance/allowance subtraction.
_spender is the approval key written by approve().
Target address a is the destination of the arbitrary delegatecall.
_UNI is a short-lived local pair address used only inside ensure()'s whitelist check.
_tos is the recipient array iterated by batchSend().
spender selects the account credited by the _mints() write.
saleNum is stored into _saleNum by init().
Loop counter i only controls the batchSend() iteration.
_supply is scaled into totalSupply by the constructor.
addr is written into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress().
